decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing house.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 01A recieved 01 April 2011 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side wall of the outbuilding hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The detached outbuilding hereby approved shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the single-family house known as 24 New Heston Road and for no other purpose (i.e. it shall not be used as a bedroom, living room, office or other business use or as a seperate dwelling and shall not include kitchen or bathroom facilities).
